description.zh:
要查询近源流量压制配置的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
An array consisting of information about the IDs of the instances that you want to query.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询实例近源流量压制配置

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于查询DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的近源流量压制配置。

> 本接口只适用于DDoS高防（中国内地）服务。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query the Diversion from Origin Server configurations of one or more Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instances.

>  This operation is suitable only for Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland).

### [](#qps-)QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-block-status --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
